data.body:
LEAF 8ce5 cream-capitate-snake — IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE (phases 4e-4f green).

Re-dispatch closed both held-out gaps without touching a test: _validate_manifest() extracted along
the seam I named, built from _validate_divergence / _validate_symbol_pairing / _validate_entries.
Divergence reasons are now validated on ANY entry regardless of correspondence (absent/empty/blank
=> UNJUSTIFIED DIVERGENCE naming the tool; non-object => MALFORMED DIVERGENCE), and descriptor
coherence is enforced both directions (exact|co_names require non-null library_symbol; mcp_only
requires null => INCOHERENT DESCRIPTOR). Coherence runs FIRST over both manifest and live surface,
deduped. evaluate() stayed pure/injectable.

FULL HELD-OUT ORACLE: 23/23 PASS.

DEFECT-SEEDED MUTATION (run under macOS sandbox-exec denying writes outside the worktree + scratch,
per protocol; script backed up and restored, trap on EXIT/INT/TERM):
  baseline                                        18 passed
  M1 neuter mandatory-reason validation            3 FAILED  <- teeth
  M2 neuter symbol/correspondence coherence        1 FAILED  <- teeth
  M3 drop the repo_root normalization rule         1 FAILED  <- teeth
  restored                                        18 passed
M3 is the important one: it proves the repo_root normalization test — one of the positive
assertions I flagged at RED as passing trivially against a permissive stub — is load-bearing
against a real defect, not a tautology.

REFACTORING LITMUS: assertions are on exit codes and message content (tool named, --update named),
not internal structure. The only structural coupling is to evaluate/build_live_surface/render_manifest/
parse_manifest/main, which ARE the module's documented contract (test-design.md permits asserting
structure only when it is itself the contract).

MERGED the held-out file into tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py (348 lines, 23 tests) — hold-out
is a process device and must not leak into the shipped codebase as a '_heldout' filename. Docstring
records the mutation evidence.

PRE-FLIGHT 4f: make lint rc=0 (new gate prints 'MCP/library parity: OK (65 tools — 35 exact,
14 co_names, 16 MCP-only; normalized on [repo_root])'), mypy clean 728 files, 23/23 tests.
One lint fix of my own test code: PLW1510 subprocess.run needed explicit check=False (the exit code
IS the assertion).

ACCEPTED DEVIATION: script is 557 lines, over the 200-500 house TARGET but well under the 800 hard
cap, and the module-size GATE scopes to src/rebar/**/*.py only (scripts/ is outside it; sibling
check_complexity_baseline.py is 737 lines). Splitting would produce a sub-100-LOC file, which the
policy explicitly forbids. Accepted rather than mechanically split.

CLAIMS: 15f2 and b0ac re-reviews PASSED -> sign-review -> certified -> CLAIMED. f9b9 and 9ca8 in
flight. Claimed so far: epic 87cb, 8ce5, 0880, 15f2, b0ac.
